lang.note: You can change the language later from the System menu. The game restarts to apply it; saves are shared between languages.
title.footer: Offline native game · progress is saved on this computer · original pixel art
system.storage_memory_hint: The save folder cannot be written, so progress lasts only until you quit.

system.shortcuts_list: WASD / arrows pan · mouse wheel or +/− zoom · right-drag pan · Tab or PgUp/PgDn change ship level · H hide sails · R rotate · Esc cancel or menu · In battle: Space pause, 1/2/4 speed

guide.title: Getting started · {n}/{total}
guide.hide_tip: Turns these tips off. System > Settings can show them again.
guide.levels: Your ship has several levels. Pick one here, or press PgDn / PgUp, to look below deck at the cabins, galley and hold.
guide.chart: Your first goal is {location}. Press Set sail to open the sea chart and plan the voyage.

guide.site: You have landed. Click a glowing room marker and the party walks there. Fights and searches cost stamina (top bar).

ship.level_open_hint: Exposed decks: circulation, rigging and the boarding fight. Only fittings such as the lookout, boarding gate and guard post may stand here.
ship.level_interior_hint: Interior level: cabins, galley, workshops, storage and other rooms. Upper decks are cut away while this level is shown.

hull.starter.desc: A stout sloop: an open weather deck for boarding fights above a gun deck and a hold for rooms.
hull.voyager.desc: A brig with a raised quarterdeck, a long gun deck and a deeper hold.
hull.adventurer.desc: A frigate with forecastle and quarterdeck, and three interior levels: gun deck, orlop and hold.
hull.legend.desc: A towering galleon with a poop deck over the quarterdeck and three broad interior levels.
ship.build_zone_note: Rooms are built on interior levels below the weather deck. The weather deck stays clear for crew movement and boarding fights; only naval fittings go there.
system.audio_note: Music and sound: Thimras, beardalaxy, Eldritch Grim (OpenGameArt), Kenney, and BigSoundBank recordists. All CC0. Sources and licences are listed in licenses/AUDIO_LICENSES.md next to the game.

collectible.relic_tide_compass.name: Tide Compass
collectible.relic_tide_compass.desc: A brass compass that always points toward the nearest safe harbour.
collectible.relic_saltglass_prism.name: Saltglass Prism
collectible.relic_saltglass_prism.desc: A cloudy prism that turns sea light into a warm, steady glow.
collectible.relic_harbor_bell.name: Harbor Bell
collectible.relic_harbor_bell.desc: Its ring once guided fishing boats home through the fog.
collectible.lore_dawnwater_1.name: The First Landing
collectible.lore_dawnwater_1.desc: The first settlers found a sheltered bay and swore the tide would never take it.
collectible.lore_dawnwater_2.name: A Chart in the Rain
collectible.lore_dawnwater_2.desc: A drowned cartographer's last map showed a route no living sailor remembers.
collectible.curio_dawnwater_1.name: Saltglass Bead
collectible.curio_dawnwater_1.desc: A smooth bead worn by dock children for luck.
collectible.trophy_harbor_leviathan.name: Harbor Leviathan Crest
collectible.trophy_harbor_leviathan.desc: Proof of defeating the Harbor Leviathan.
collectible.trophy_golden_crab.name: Golden Crab Trophy
collectible.trophy_golden_crab.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Golden Crab.
collectible.chart_dawnwater.name: Chart of Dawnwater

enemy.tide_jelly.name: Tide Jelly
bestiary.tide_jelly.lore: A drifting bell of translucent flesh. Its sting lingers long after the light fades.
enemy.shoal_ray.name: Shoal Ray
bestiary.shoal_ray.lore: It glides a hand's breadth above the seabed, wings silent, eyes never closing.
enemy.brine_worm.name: Brine Worm
bestiary.brine_worm.lore: A segmented bulk that reshapes the wreck it nests in. The hull learned to fear it.
enemy.harbor_leviathan.name: Harbor Leviathan
bestiary.harbor_leviathan.lore: It has slept beneath the harbour for a hundred years, and the harbour has learned to sleep around it.
enemy.golden_crab.name: Golden Crab
bestiary.golden_crab.lore: A crab whose shell grew rich on shipwreck gold. It has never once been caught.
set.set_dawnwater.name: Dawnwater Collection
set.set_dawnwater.desc: A complete record of Dawnwater: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
collectible.relic_ember_lodestone.name: Ember Lodestone
collectible.relic_ember_lodestone.desc: Warm to the touch, it pulls blades toward an enemy's guard.
collectible.relic_cinder_lens.name: Cinder Lens
collectible.relic_cinder_lens.desc: Smoke-grey glass that reveals the weak points in armour.
collectible.relic_forge_ember.name: Forge Ember
collectible.relic_forge_ember.desc: An ember that has outlived every forge in the Reach.
collectible.lore_emberreach_1.name: The Vent That Sang
collectible.lore_emberreach_1.desc: Miners followed a singing vent and found a cavern full of molten glass.
collectible.lore_emberreach_2.name: Ash and Iron
collectible.lore_emberreach_2.desc: The old forge clans buried their dead with hammers, not coins.
collectible.curio_emberreach_1.name: Slag Rosette
collectible.curio_emberreach_1.desc: A flower of cooled slag, prized by collectors for its colour.
collectible.trophy_magma_hydra.name: Magma Hydra Crest
collectible.trophy_magma_hydra.desc: Proof of defeating the Magma Hydra.
collectible.trophy_cinder_moth.name: Cinder Moth Trophy
collectible.trophy_cinder_moth.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Cinder Moth.
collectible.chart_emberreach.name: Chart of Emberreach
collectible.chart_emberreach.desc: A chart marking a wreck in the Emberreach. Use it at the site to open the stash.
enemy.cinder_jelly.name: Cinder Jelly
bestiary.cinder_jelly.lore: A jelly lit from within by a coal that refuses to go out.
enemy.magma_ray.name: Magma Ray
bestiary.magma_ray.lore: It swims through molten stone as if the sea were only a rumour.
enemy.ash_worm.name: Ash Worm
bestiary.ash_worm.lore: Its rings are packed with ash from a hundred burned fleets.
enemy.magma_hydra.name: Magma Hydra
bestiary.magma_hydra.lore: Cut one head from the molten dark and two more rise to take its place.
enemy.cinder_moth.name: Cinder Moth
bestiary.cinder_moth.lore: Its wings are made of cooled ash. Where it lands, the wood remembers fire.
set.set_emberreach.name: Emberreach Collection
set.set_emberreach.desc: A complete record of Emberreach: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
collectible.relic_thornwood_idol.name: Thornwood Idol
collectible.relic_thornwood_idol.desc: A small idol carved from a tree that grew through a shipwreck.
collectible.relic_sporeglass_vial.name: Sporeglass Vial
collectible.relic_sporeglass_vial.desc: A vial of glowing spores that never settle.
collectible.relic_rootheart_seed.name: Rootheart Seed
collectible.relic_rootheart_seed.desc: Still warm, still waiting for soil.
collectible.lore_verdant_maw_1.name: The Green Wreck
collectible.lore_verdant_maw_1.desc: A galleon swallowed by the jungle, its cannon now a planter.
collectible.lore_verdant_maw_2.name: What the Roots Remember
collectible.lore_verdant_maw_2.desc: The roots remember every sailor who fell in the Maw.
collectible.curio_verdant_maw_1.name: Amber Seedpod
collectible.curio_verdant_maw_1.desc: A seedpod that glows faintly when held to the ear.
collectible.trophy_spore_matriarch.name: Spore Matriarch Crest
collectible.trophy_spore_matriarch.desc: Proof of defeating the Spore Matriarch.
collectible.trophy_elder_mossback.name: Elder Mossback Trophy
collectible.trophy_elder_mossback.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Elder Mossback.
collectible.chart_verdant_maw.name: Chart of Verdant Maw
collectible.chart_verdant_maw.desc: A chart marking a wreck in the Verdant Maw. Use it at the site to open the stash.
enemy.spore_jelly.name: Spore Jelly
bestiary.spore_jelly.lore: A breathing cloud of spores shaped like a bell. It is never alone.
enemy.canopy_ray.name: Canopy Ray
bestiary.canopy_ray.lore: It hunts beneath the mangrove canopy, where the water is green and blind.
enemy.mire_worm.name: Mire Worm
bestiary.mire_worm.lore: The swamp closes over its back and calls it ground.
enemy.spore_matriarch.name: Spore Matriarch
bestiary.spore_matriarch.lore: Every breath in the Maw carries her children. Every wreck is her nursery.
enemy.elder_mossback.name: Elder Mossback
bestiary.elder_mossback.lore: A beast so old that a forest has taken root on its back.
set.set_verdant_maw.name: Verdant Maw Collection
set.set_verdant_maw.desc: A complete record of Verdant Maw: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
collectible.relic_prism_sextant.name: Prism Sextant
collectible.relic_prism_sextant.desc: It measures the angle of light, not the stars.
collectible.relic_refraction_shard.name: Refraction Shard
collectible.relic_refraction_shard.desc: A shard that shows a different horizon in each facet.
collectible.relic_mirror_sail.name: Mirror Sail
collectible.relic_mirror_sail.desc: A scrap of sailcloth that reflects the sea instead of the sky.
collectible.lore_glass_current_1.name: The Fleet of Mirrors
collectible.lore_glass_current_1.desc: Sailors say a fleet of glass ships once crossed the Current and vanished.
collectible.lore_glass_current_2.name: The Queen's Reflection
collectible.lore_glass_current_2.desc: The refraction queen keeps every reflection she has ever stolen.
collectible.curio_glass_current_1.name: Prism Marble
collectible.curio_glass_current_1.desc: A marble that splits sunlight into seven thin blades.

enemy.prism_jelly.name: Prism Jelly
bestiary.prism_jelly.lore: Seven colours drift inside it, none of them its own.
enemy.shard_ray.name: Shard Ray
bestiary.shard_ray.lore: It is not one animal but a school of glass splinters keeping a shape.
enemy.glass_worm.name: Glass Worm
bestiary.glass_worm.lore: A living tube of clear glass. You see your own blood move inside it.
enemy.prism_serpent.name: Prism Serpent
bestiary.prism_serpent.lore: Its scales are mirrors. Look too long and you will see yourself losing.
enemy.mirror_ray.name: Mirror Ray
bestiary.mirror_ray.lore: A ray with no colour of its own, only the sea it borrows.
set.set_glass_current.name: Glass Current Collection
set.set_glass_current.desc: A complete record of Glass Current: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
collectible.relic_gilded_seal.name: Gilded Seal
collectible.relic_gilded_seal.desc: The seal of a merchant house that no longer exists.
collectible.relic_silk_ledger.name: Silk Ledger
collectible.relic_silk_ledger.desc: Every debt written in it is still owed.
collectible.relic_crown_coin.name: Crown Coin
collectible.relic_crown_coin.desc: A coin stamped on both sides with the same face.
collectible.lore_crown_shoals_1.name: The Family Debt
collectible.lore_crown_shoals_1.desc: The founding families bought the shoals with a promise they never intended to keep.
collectible.lore_crown_shoals_2.name: A Coin for the Ferryman
collectible.lore_crown_shoals_2.desc: The old crypt is said to hold a coin that always returns.
collectible.curio_crown_shoals_1.name: Gilded Shell
collectible.curio_crown_shoals_1.desc: A shell plated in gold by a jeweller with more money than sense.

enemy.coin_jelly.name: Coin Jelly
bestiary.coin_jelly.lore: It has swallowed so many coins that its bell rings when it moves.
enemy.gilded_ray.name: Gilded Ray
bestiary.gilded_ray.lore: Its underside is plated with stolen leaf and coin.
enemy.vault_worm.name: Vault Worm
bestiary.vault_worm.lore: It nests inside a sunken vault and wears the door as a crown.
enemy.gilded_kraken.name: Gilded Kraken
bestiary.gilded_kraken.lore: It wears the treasury it swallowed. Every coin is a scale.
enemy.coin_drake.name: Coin Drake
bestiary.coin_drake.lore: A serpent that hoards coins it cannot spend, in a nest it cannot leave.

collectible.relic_storm_anchor.name: Storm Anchor
collectible.relic_storm_anchor.desc: An anchor that has held through nine typhoons.
collectible.relic_thunder_feather.name: Thunder Feather
collectible.relic_thunder_feather.desc: A feather that crackles before every storm.
collectible.relic_squall_glass.name: Squall Glass
collectible.relic_squall_glass.desc: A stormglass that fills with lightning instead of crystals.
collectible.lore_stormbelt_1.name: The Beacon That Would Not Die

collectible.lore_stormbelt_2.name: Squall's Log
collectible.lore_stormbelt_2.desc: A captain's log written in one hand, then another, then another.
collectible.curio_stormbelt_1.name: Stormglass Eye
collectible.curio_stormbelt_1.desc: A glass eye that clouds before lightning strikes.

enemy.storm_jelly.name: Storm Jelly
bestiary.storm_jelly.lore: Its bell is a thunderhead. Its tendrils are rain that stings.
enemy.squall_ray.name: Squall Ray
bestiary.squall_ray.lore: It rides the underside of waves, faster than the wind above.
enemy.thunder_worm.name: Thunder Worm
bestiary.thunder_worm.lore: Each segment holds a charge. When it dies, the storm gets it back.
enemy.thunder_roc.name: Thunder Roc
bestiary.thunder_roc.lore: It nests in the eye of the storm and has never touched the sea.
enemy.storm_roc.name: Storm Roc
bestiary.storm_roc.lore: A younger roc with a longer temper and a shorter memory.

collectible.relic_moon_lantern.name: Moon Lantern
collectible.relic_moon_lantern.desc: It burns with a light that only dreamers can see.
collectible.relic_dream_marble.name: Dream Marble
collectible.relic_dream_marble.desc: A marble that rolls uphill when no one watches.
collectible.lore_moonwake_1.name: The Observatory Below
collectible.lore_moonwake_1.desc: The observatory charts a sky that does not exist above the sea.
collectible.curio_moonwake_1.name: Sleeping Pearl
collectible.curio_moonwake_1.desc: A pearl that grows heavier with every nightmare it eats.
collectible.trophy_dream_eater.name: Dream Eater Crest
collectible.trophy_dream_eater.desc: Proof of defeating the Dream Eater.

bestiary.dream_jelly.lore: It drifts through sleep, and sleep drifts through it.
enemy.moon_ray.name: Moon Ray
bestiary.moon_ray.lore: Its wings are the colour of a cloud crossing the moon.
enemy.nightmare_worm.name: Nightmare Worm
bestiary.nightmare_worm.lore: It burrows through the space behind closed eyes.
enemy.dream_eater.name: Dream Eater
bestiary.dream_eater.lore: It has no face of its own, so it borrows the face of whoever is dreaming.
enemy.lunar_moth.name: Lunar Moth
bestiary.lunar_moth.lore: Its wings hold the last light of a moon that set long ago.
set.set_moonwake.name: Moonwake Collection
set.set_moonwake.desc: A complete record of Moonwake: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
collectible.relic_abyss_ring.name: Abyss Ring
collectible.relic_abyss_ring.desc: Cold iron from a trench that has never seen daylight.
collectible.relic_pale_compass.name: Pale Compass
collectible.relic_pale_compass.desc: Its needle points down, always down.
collectible.lore_ashen_trench_1.name: The Sealed Door
collectible.lore_ashen_trench_1.desc: A door at the bottom of the trench is sealed from the inside.
collectible.curio_ashen_trench_1.name: Pale Alloy Ingot
collectible.curio_ashen_trench_1.desc: An ingot that drinks lamplight and gives back nothing.
collectible.trophy_void_angler.name: Void Angler Crest
collectible.trophy_void_angler.desc: Proof of defeating the Void Angler.

collectible.trophy_pale_angler.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Pale Angler.

bestiary.abyss_jelly.lore: No light reaches it, so it makes its own.

bestiary.pale_ray.lore: It has no shadow, because nothing down here casts one.
enemy.trench_worm.name: Trench Worm
bestiary.trench_worm.lore: It is longer than the wreck it circles and older than the trench.

bestiary.void_angler.lore: Its lure is a small sun. The dark around it is not empty.
enemy.pale_angler.name: Pale Angler
bestiary.pale_angler.lore: A deep angler that has eaten so much light it has become pale.

collectible.relic_scale_talisman.desc: A scale from the world serpent, still warm.
collectible.relic_leviathan_pearl.name: Leviathan Pearl
collectible.relic_leviathan_pearl.desc: A pearl the size of a fist, heavy with drowned songs.
collectible.lore_leviathan_ring_1.name: The Ring of Bones
collectible.lore_leviathan_ring_1.desc: The ring is not a reef; it is the ribs of something older than the sea.
collectible.curio_leviathan_ring_1.name: Leviathan Tooth
collectible.curio_leviathan_ring_1.desc: A tooth worn smooth by a hundred years of tide.
collectible.trophy_world_serpent.name: World Serpent Crest
collectible.trophy_world_serpent.desc: Proof of defeating the World Serpent.

collectible.trophy_island_whale.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Island Whale.

collectible.chart_leviathan_ring.desc: A chart marking a wreck in the Leviathan Ring. Use it at the site to open the stash.
enemy.leviathan_jelly.name: Leviathan Jelly
bestiary.leviathan_jelly.lore: A bell the size of a chapel, drifting with the world serpent's pulse.

bestiary.reef_ray.lore: It carries a reef on its back, and the reef carries hunters.
enemy.shell_worm.name: Shell Worm
bestiary.shell_worm.lore: Its shell is made of the plates of things that tried to eat it.
enemy.world_serpent.name: World Serpent
bestiary.world_serpent.lore: The ring is its body. The currents are its breath. The sea is its dream.
enemy.island_whale.name: Island Whale
bestiary.island_whale.lore: Sailors have charted it as an island three times.

set.set_leviathan_ring.desc: A complete record of Leviathan Ring: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.

collectible.relic_horizon_compass.desc: It points at the place where the sun is always rising.
collectible.relic_dawnglass.name: Dawnglass
collectible.relic_dawnglass.desc: A pane of glass that holds the first light of morning.
collectible.lore_grand_horizon_1.name: The Last Gate
collectible.lore_grand_horizon_1.desc: Beyond the horizon gate, the sea ends and something else begins.
collectible.curio_grand_horizon_1.name: First Light Prism
collectible.curio_grand_horizon_1.desc: It splits dawn into colours no sailor has named.
collectible.trophy_dawn_titan.name: Dawn Titan Crest
collectible.trophy_dawn_titan.desc: Proof of defeating the Dawn Titan.

collectible.trophy_aurora_wyrm.desc: Proof of defeating the elusive Aurora Wyrm.

bestiary.star_jelly.lore: A jelly full of small lights, each one a place it has never been.
enemy.horizon_ray.name: Horizon Ray
bestiary.horizon_ray.lore: It leaps farther than the eye can follow and lands on the other side of the light.
enemy.dawn_worm.name: Dawn Worm
bestiary.dawn_worm.lore: Its rings are the colour of a sunrise seen from below the sea.
enemy.dawn_titan.name: Dawn Titan
bestiary.dawn_titan.lore: It was old when the first ship was built. It is still waiting at the gate.
enemy.aurora_wyrm.name: Aurora Wyrm
bestiary.aurora_wyrm.lore: Its wake is a ribbon of colour across a sky that has no night.

enemy.swarmling.name: Swarmling
bestiary.swarmling.lore: A palm-sized hunter that only feels brave in a crowd.

set.set_storm.name: Stormchaser's Cabinet
set.set_storm.desc: Every small strange thing the sea gave up after a storm.
